name: frost_window
theme: a winter windowpane at night that never leaves the glass — the whole frosted pane, one ice fern arm, its beaded side branches, the hexagonal crystal within, and the lattice read back out as the frost ferns ranked across the dark pane

registers.name: frost_pane
registers.scene: a tall winter windowpane of cold glass, dozens of white frost ferns etched thick across it in every direction, feathered spines and ranks of fine branches interlocking edge to edge, pale blue winter light coming through from behind
registers.target: a white frost fern, a broad ice frond with a thick pale spine
registers.loop_target: the winter windowpane seen straight on from inside the dark room, white frost ferns etched thick across the cold glass in warm raking light

registers.name: fern_arm
registers.scene: one arm of a white frost fern on a cold windowpane, a thick pale spine with ranks of slender branches angled off it in sharp white ice, dark bare glass between them, more ferns etched across the pane beyond
registers.target: a single ice branch, slender spurs strung with round clear beads

registers.name: beaded_branch
registers.scene: a single ice branch on the frosted windowpane, slender white spurs strung with round beads of clear ice, each bead a smooth plain drop of frozen glass, the dark flat pane and further white spurs behind
registers.target: a hexagonal ice crystal, six flat clear faces meeting at sharp bright edges

registers.name: ice_lattice
registers.scene: the inside of an ice crystal, hexagonal rings of clear ice repeating in every direction, six-sided cells of pale blue light ranked through a vast bright lattice

registers.name: dark_window
registers.scene: a tall cabin window in the dark, the whole pane pale inside its plain wooden frame, white frost ferns crowded edge to edge in ranks across the black glass, a warm lamp at one end of the sill throwing gold light along the ice, the room empty, no one present

music_theme: hushed winter stillness at a lamplit window, glassy bell tones over slow warm strings, a single crystalline chime landing on the lattice morph
